summary: The exact candidate fixes the 13 concrete constructor sites carried forward from the prior independent review, and its focused regression suite passes. It does not fully resolve the original issue: the original source scan still fails, with 25 syntactic omissions. Seven pass quant_config=None, but 18 pass a live quantization configuration without a prefix. An independent SolarForCausalLM constructor probe demonstrates the original empty-prefix behavior on the candidate.

40 tests and 42 subtests passed, covering the candidate's reviewed prefixes and earlier PR regressions.
All 13 concrete counterexamples from the prior independent review have an explicit qualified prefix.

remaining_limitations: No Solar, DeepSeek-VL2, GPT-2, LFM2-VL, LongCat, MiMo, Nemotron-NAS, Qwen3-Omni, or Step3.5 model weights were available, so full-model semantic and serving tests were not run.

Only the Solar remaining failure was independently executed at a constructor boundary; the other 17 live-config omissions are source-level counterexamples requiring architecture-specific runtime qualification before correction.

The prepared environment is ROCm 7.2 on one AMD Instinct MI350X, whereas the issue snapshot used CUDA on an RTX 4090. This does not affect the CPU-only prefix-routing reproduction but prevents claiming cross-architecture model execution.
No native files differ between the base and candidate, so there was no native library to rebuild. The imported sglang source was /job/repo/python/sglang/__init__.py.
